source_message.speaker: freelancer
source_message.text:
This one was exceptionally difficult.

- I detected and removed 19 different hacking backdoors, which suggests that several parties probably hacked the site.
- All of the malware spam posts arrived in May, while the earliest attack files were uploaded in April.
- Given how severe the infection is, restoring an earlier backup is the best approach. However, the earliest version available on WP-Engine was created on June 24th, and it is infected too.
- The removal was completed, but there were some problems with the page and post status.

I'm going to make another fresh attempt.

execution.observed_behavior: Page and post status problems remained after the initial malware-removal attempt, requiring another restoration attempt.

source_message.speaker: freelancer
source_message.text:
Sorry, I missed my previous follow-up.

**Latest update.**
According to the database, every page was moved to Trash on July 1st. That is when the website stopped functioning entirely.

We have now restored the site to the 28th June's backup, and it appears normal again. I am using this version for the malware removal work.

execution.observed_behavior: After restoration to the June 28 backup, the site appeared normal again rather than having every page in Trash.
